svg.title: Durable Functions classify every upload and index it for chat within minutes
svg.desc: Document classification with Azure Functions and Microsoft Foundry

text.tspan: Durable Functions classify every upload and index it for chat within minutes
Document classification with Azure Functions and Microsoft Foundry
Users upload documents through the web
app; files land in Blob Storage.
The web app posts a message per upload to
The queue triggers a Durable Functions
Intelligence to classify and extract content.
type and location in Azure Cosmos DB.
The embedding activity chunks the text,
embeds it and indexes it in Azure AI Search.
Users ask questions in the web app, which
The agent retrieves the relevant chunks
from the index and answers with citations.
